title: Paper 10 §3 Data and Preliminaries Initial Draft

subsections.title: Sample Construction
key_claims: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, no license restriction
seed 42 fixed for all downstream bootstrap/resampling

subsections.title: Return and Realized-Volatility Definitions
key_claims: log returns r_t = ln(P_t / P_{t-1}) for SPY and BTC
VIX used at level (already a volatility index)

subsections.title: Descriptive Statistics and Preliminary Diagnostics
key_claims: Both returns fat-tailed; SPY skew -0.307 more pronounced than BTC
VIX range 9.14 to 82.69 spans calm-to-COVID regimes
ADF rejects unit-root null at 1% for all three inputs

table_1.caption: Descriptive Statistics for BTC/SPY Log Returns and VIX, 2015-02-02 to 2026-04-08, N=2812

eth_sol_inclusion.rationale: body_v0_intro.tex abstract, K1234 kickoff guide §3, and all three supporting experiments (K639/K746b/K1025) lock scope to SPY + BTC + VIX. Adding ETH/SOL would require new K12xx supporting experiments and contradict §1 as drafted.

cfix_inclusion.rationale: VIX is the paper's chosen fear proxy per §1. CFIX is endogenous to crypto and would muddle the BTC-to-equity transmission identification.

correlation_matrix_placement.rationale: Unconditional correlation is uninteresting; regime-conditional correlation is the paper's claim.

ljung_box_jb_placement.rationale: ~600 word budget is tight; ADF diagnostics alone suffice for §3 main text.
